system.description:
As a Free Action on your turn, you can make a Use the Force check against a living creature within 12 squares, removing one use of the Farseeing Force Power from your active Force Power Suite (as though you had activated the Force Power).

If your check result equals or exceeds the Will Defense of the target, you gain a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls against that target until the end of your turn. This counts as using the Farseeing Force Power against that target, but this Talent replaces the normal rules and effects of that Force Power.
